hooks.command: sh -c 'repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire.exe"; if [ ! -f "$entire" ]; then entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire"; fi; if [ -f "$entire" ]; then "$entire" hooks codex post-tool-use; fi'

sh -c 'repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire.exe"; if [ ! -f "$entire" ]; then entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire"; fi; if [ -f "$entire" ]; then "$entire" hooks codex session-start; fi; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$repo/scripts/complete-git-session-archive.ps1" -Phase session-start'

sh -c 'repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire.exe"; if [ ! -f "$entire" ]; then entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire"; fi; if [ -f "$entire" ]; then "$entire" hooks codex stop; fi; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$repo/scripts/complete-git-session-archive.ps1" -Phase stop'

sh -c 'repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire.exe"; if [ ! -f "$entire" ]; then entire="$repo/.codex-tools/bin/entire"; fi; if [ -f "$entire" ]; then "$entire" hooks codex user-prompt-submit; fi'
